RF_S1E01_S01.summary: Dock departure at Luminara fields. Farm freighters load with grain.

RF_S1E01_S02.summary: Convoy enters Kaldr Rift. A convoy emerges into debris-strewn corridor.

RF_S1E01_S03.summary: Verge escort tension with Thunderbreak. CAPTAIN NAOMI SOL clenches her jaw, watching the Thunderbreak take lead.

RF_S1E01_S04.summary: Raiders ambush convoy. Thunderbreak SLAMS a derelict sideways into raiders, shielding a convoy ship.

RF_S1E01_S05.summary: Interior chaos: boarders torch freighter. Red strobes, zero-G.

RF_S1E01_S06.summary: Thunderbreak rams derelict sideways. Commodore ELLA VENN watches Billie’s vectors dance across her holo.

RF_S1E01_S08.summary: Memorial ceremony on Thunderbreak. Crew gather in a semicircle.

RF_S1E01_S09.summary: Naomi vs Venn corridor debate. The Mother and Boy disembark with other survivors.

RF_S1E01_S10.summary: Auric Bazaar traders and Jex Marrin. In the dark, the ASHFANG MARAUDER idles among jagged rock.

RF_S1E01_S11.summary: Raiders regroup, Billie Rusk. In the dark, the ASHFANG MARAUDER idles among jagged rock.
